title: get_share_info params
description: Returns a share card for the running server. For a tcp, udp or direct-p2p server, address and port are those the server is bound to, with a detected local IPv4 address when it is bound to every interface. For a relay server it first registers a new relay token for the card, for at most 15 seconds; other commands are handled meanwhile. The card carries the server's fingerprint as fingerprint_emoji, fingerprint_hex and fingerprint_numeric, the last being the one for the peer to compare.
